correctness.rationale: Independence of the Gamma radial factor and Haar complex-sphere direction gives exact normalized moments. Proper-Gaussian Wick expansion yields E T=2n^2 and E T^2=4n^4+(56n^3+4n)/3; symbolic rational subtraction gives the claimed variance. For CLT, the normalized fourth moment is fourth-Wick integral plus negligible squared L2 fluctuation; connected cumulant graphs admit an L1 Dirichlet-kernel spanning-tree bound \(C_q((1+\log n)/n)^{q-1}\), so only the variance 8/3 remains. The extracted standalone checker independently evaluated Gaussian monomials for n<=7 and passed 46 assertions. No finite-check-to-infinite-proof inference is made.
